latestKnowledge.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
latestKnowledge.summary: External retrieval failed, so the strongest actionable synthesis is to avoid broader hard regime blocks and instead use narrowly scoped regime-conditional exit tightening, asymmetric counter-trend throttling in trend_down, and trade-count recovery via selective re-entry or setup-tier gating.
